title: Scalar projection for a quotient coefficient is invertible
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $d$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $R_T$ for its completed coefficient sheaf, $R_T^0$ for the limit of constant finite quotient sheaves, and $b_T:R_T^0\cong R_T$ for the canonical limit comparison [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Assume the canonical completed coefficient map $c_f:f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$ is invertible. Let $F^{\rm ab}$ be an additive ordinary functor with an equality identifying it with generic ringed direct image over $R_Y,R_X$ with coefficient isomorphism $\operatorname{asIso}(c_f)$, and put $F=R(F^{\rm ab})$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and $F^0,L^0$ direct image and pullback over $R^0$ with the canonical completed coefficient identification [lemma-weil-pbc-perfect-projection-formula]. Choose arbitrary commutative ring sheaves $S_Y,S_X$, maps $\varphi_T:R_T\to S_T$, and $c:f^{-1}S_Y\cong S_X$ such that $c_f;\varphi_X=f^{-1}(\varphi_Y);c$. Choose an additive ordinary functor $G^{\rm ab}$ equal to ringed direct image with coefficient isomorphism $c$, and put $G=R(G^{\rm ab})$ and let $E_T\dashv U_T$ be derived extension and exact restriction along $\varphi_T$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Suppose $i:U_X^{\rm ab};F^{\rm ab}\cong G^{\rm ab};U_Y^{\rm ab}$ is identity on underlying sections and $e:U_X;F\cong G;U_Y$ is its derived comparison, normalized by the universal right-derived units on every cochain complex $C$: $u_F(U_X C);F(\rho_X^{-1}(C));e_{QC}=Q(i_C);\rho_Y^{-1}(G^\bullet C);U_Y(u_G(C))$. Here $\rho_T$ is the canonical localization comparison for exact restriction and $u_F,u_G$ are the universal derived units. No finiteness, flatness or perfectness of $S_T$ over $R_T$ is assumed. Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and fix an isomorphism from $(\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y;\varphi_Y}S_Y)[0]$ to the canonical quotient object $Q_n$ of $D(R_Y^0)$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For every unbounded $K\in D(R_X)$, the scalar-adjunction mate $E_YF(K)\to GE_X(K)$ of $F(\eta_X(K));e_{E_XK}$ is invertible. No boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is imposed on $K$.

proof.text: Apply the scalar/tensor comparison with P equal to the canonical nth positive quotient and with the given degree-zero identification r. It gives tensor models, source and target isomorphisms, and equality of the restricted scalar mate with the tensor projection after those isomorphisms.

The quotient is site-perfect by PerfectProjection.reductionMap_isIso. The site-perfect clause of PerfectProjection.perfect_projection_formula therefore makes the tensor projection invertible for these tensor models and the transported input. Cancel the source and target comparison isomorphisms.

Derived scalar restriction is conservative: commute restriction with homology through its exact-functor homology comparison, reflect module-sheaf isomorphisms under ordinary restriction, and detect derived isomorphisms on all homology groups. Reflect along the completed coefficient comparison and then along the target coefficient map to obtain invertibility of the scalar mate.

theorem completedScalarProjectionPerfectIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) [IsIso (completedCoefficientMap f d)]
    (SY : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (SX : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (φY : pbcAdicCompletion Y d ⟶ SY) (φX : pbcAdicCompletion X d ⟶ SX)
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj SY ≅ SX)
    (hc : completedCoefficientMap f d ≫ φX =
      (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map φY ≫ c.hom)
    (F : pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d) ⥤ pbcModules Y (pbcAdicCompletion Y d))
    [F.Additive]
    (hF : F = proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f (pbcAdicCompletion Y d)
      (pbcAdicCompletion X d) (asIso (completedCoefficientMap f d)))
    (G : pbcModules X SX ⥤ pbcModules Y SY) [G.Additive]
    (hG : G = proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f SY SX c)
    (i : pbcRestrict φX ⋙ F ≅
      G ⋙ pbcRestrict φY)
    (hi : ∀ (M : pbcModules X SX) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ),
      HEq (fun x ↦ (i.hom.app M).val.app U x)
        (fun x : ((proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f SY SX c).obj M).val.obj U ↦ x))
    (e : pbcDerivedRestrict φX ⋙ F.rightDerivedFunctor ≅
      G.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ pbcDerivedRestrict φY)
    (he : ∀ C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X SX) ℤ,
      F.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ
          (((pbcRestrict φX).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((pbcRestrict φX).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app C) ≫
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex i.hom (.up ℤ)).app C) ≫
        (pbcRestrict φY).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
          ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        (pbcDerivedRestrict φY).map (G.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ C))
    (n : ℕ)
    (r : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (PerfectProjection.modules d Y) 0).obj
        ((pbcRestrict ((pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom ≫ φY)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (reductionModuleRing Y SY))) ≅ PerfectProjection.quotient d Y n)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d))) :
    IsIso (((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φY).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (F.rightDerivedFunctor.map ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φX).unit.app K) ≫
        e.hom.app ((pbcDerivedExtend φX).obj K)))
